title: Transcriptional response of primary human pancreatic cancer-associated fibroblasts to IFN-γ and lipopolysaccharide stimulation
summary: Single-cell analysis of a pan-cancer tumor microenvironment atlas identified transcriptionally distinct inflammatory cancer-associated fibroblast (iCAF) subpopulations, including an ISG15+ iCAF population predicted to arise downstream of interferon-γ signaling from CD8+/GZMB+ T cells, and a CXCL8+ iCAF population. To test these predictions experimentally, primary cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) were isolated from a fresh human pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) surgical specimen, expanded in culture, and treated for 24 hours with control media, recombinant human interferon-γ, or lipopolysaccharide (LPS). Bulk RNA-sequencing of the resulting nine libraries was used to compare the induced transcriptional programs against gene signatures derived from the ISG15+ iCAF and CXCL8+ iCAF subpopulations of the atlas. Results are reported in the associated publication.
overall_design: Bulk RNA-seq of primary human PDAC cancer-associated fibroblasts treated for 24 hours with control media, recombinant human IFN-γ (20 ng/ml), or LPS (100 ng/ml). Three independent replicate cultures per condition (nine libraries in total), all derived from a single patient primary CAF isolate at passage 4. Each library was sequenced in a dedicated lane across three Singular Genomics G4 runs performed on the same day; no index reads were performed and no index-based demultiplexing was applied.

title: Primary human PDAC cancer-associated fibroblasts, untreated control, replicate 1
treatment_protocol_ch1: Passage 4 cells (1 x 10^5 cells per replicate; n = 3 independent replicate cultures per condition) were allowed to adhere for 12 hours, after which cells were treated for 24 hours with control media, recombinant human IFN-γ (20 ng/ml; R&D #285-IF), or lipopolysaccharide (100 ng/ml; InvivoGen #tlrl-eblps).
growth_protocol_ch1: Primary cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) were isolated using the Miltenyi Biotec Tumor Dissociation Kit (#130-095-929) from one fresh pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma surgical specimen, obtained under an institutional review board approved protocol with informed consent obtained preoperatively (Stanford IRB-65893). Isolated CAFs were cultured for 4 passages in DMEM/F-12 with GlutaMAX (Gibco #10565018), 10% FBS (Gibco #16000044), 1% Antibiotic-Antimycotic (R&D #B22110) and 0.2% Primocin (InvivoGen #ant-pm-05).
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was extracted using TRIzol (Invitrogen #15596026).

RNA-seq libraries were prepared using the NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina (NEB #E7760) following the manufacturer’s protocol for the NEBNext rRNA Depletion Kit v2 (Human/Mouse/Rat) (NEB #E7400L), with 50 ng RNA input per library. During the adaptor ligation step, the Singular Genomics Universal Library Prep Adapter (#700110) was used to adapt libraries for sequencing on the Singular Genomics G4. PCR enrichment of adaptor-ligated DNA was performed for 12 cycles. No index reads were performed, as each library was sequenced in a dedicated lane.
data_processing: Basecalling and per-lane FASTQ generation were performed on the Singular Genomics G4 (paired-end, 75 bp per read; no index cycles). One library was sequenced per lane, so no index-based demultiplexing was performed.
Reads were aligned to the human GRCh37/hg19 reference genome using TopHat (v2.0.13).
Gene-level read counts were generated for each sample, yielding nine counts matrices, which were merged into a single counts matrix in R (v4.2.2).
CPM normalization was performed using the cpm function. Genes were retained if at least 2 samples had at least 0.5 CPM, leaving 26,363 genes for downstream analysis.

Differential expression between conditions was assessed using DESeq2 (v1.38.4) with a two-sided Wald test and Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment for multiple comparisons; log2 fold changes were shrunk using lfcShrink.
Assembly: hg19 (GRCh37)

Supplementary files format and content: Tab-delimited text file containing raw gene-level read counts for all nine samples. Rows are genes; columns are the nine samples (C1-C3, untreated control; F1-F3, IFN-γ treated; L1-L3, LPS treated).
